html:
Given integers, return the length of the longest strictly increasing subsequence. Equal values cannot extend it. Aim for O(n log n) time.

Call solve with the positional arguments shown in each test. Return the result; do not print.

Example

{
  "args": [
    [
      4,
      2,
      3,
      1,
      5
    ]
  ],
  "expected": 3
}

Example

{
  "args": [
    [
      7,
      7,
      7
    ]
  ],
  "expected": 1
}
Hint

For each length, keep the smallest possible ending value.

Complexity: O(n log(n+1)) time, O(n) space
